model.name: server.leveledLog
model.description: Leveled logger (error/warn/info/debug/trace = 0-4). LOG_LEVEL env var sets default. Runtime setter via POST /api/log-level or TUI key. log.error/warn/info/debug/trace gate on current level. Replace 85 ad-hoc addLog/console.log calls in server.ts. Upload/createFileUnit logs at debug/trace for Tron diagnosis.
